tasks.title: Bootstrap repository and compatible toolchain
tasks.output: Create Android/API/web project skeletons without inventing UI; pin a tested toolchain and dependency locks; add environment examples, PostGIS Compose service, CI lint/test/build jobs and documented commands.

tasks.title: Obtain and register owner-generated Stitch designs
tasks.output: Present the prepared screen briefs by batch; owner generates screens; read the designated Stitch project through MCP; save screen IDs, revisions and approved state coverage in design/stitch/SCREEN_REGISTRY.md. Repeat this gate for later batches; the initial spike needs S00 only.

tasks.title: Prove Android feasibility on a real phone
tasks.output: Implement approved S00 diagnostic screen; capture/compress photo, save/read Room row after restart, run a bundled LiteRT baseline prediction in airplane mode, record phone/toolchain/APK evidence. Baseline prediction is not the trained SahiTol classifier. Failure is a visible blocker, never automatic PWA substitution.

tasks.title: Complete secondary-research and source register
tasks.output: Build 5–7 attributed desk-research insight cards and 2–3 labelled personas; retain source/date/scope/limitations, link insights to requirement IDs; record primary fieldwork as not conducted and check the authenticated official brief/cutoff when available.

tasks.title: Build reproducible data import and validation tools
tasks.output: Implement PDF/CSV/JSON import staging, pandas cleaning, field-level lineage, cached geocoding with provider policy, validation/quarantine, duplicate detection, reproducible seed and synthetic scripts. Invalid records must remain inspectable and never count as accepted.

tasks.title: Implement PostgreSQL/PostGIS schema and migrations
tasks.output: Create tables, indexes, route/role constraints, integer money/weight, immutable events, versions and sync results. Test migration on empty DB and upgrade fixtures; verify extension and private DB permissions locally and hosted.

tasks.title: Implement phone/PIN authentication and ownership
tasks.output: Implement Argon2id PIN storage, rate-limited phone/PIN login, rotating/revocable session flow, COLLECTOR/RECYCLER/ADMIN authorization, device scoping, explicit isolated demo access, online first activation and secure Android session continuation contract.

tasks.title: Implement private media storage adapter
tasks.output: Implement local-volume and Supabase-private-storage adapters; bounded image upload/validation/checksum, short-lived authorized access, missing-upload recovery and PDF storage. No permanent files on the free API host filesystem.

tasks.title: Implement versioned reference bootstrap and delta APIs
tasks.output: Expose material/alias/safety/price/directory snapshots with versions, policy parameters, source timestamps, tombstones, expiry and opaque cursor; filter by region and role; provide labelled bundled demo cache for first offline launch.

tasks.title: Curate material taxonomy and language aliases
tasks.output: Seed every PS-named material, battery chemistry and UNKNOWN/OTHER; separate reference catalog from observed lot material; attach route, contextual safety, units, condition and hi/mr/en aliases. Add provenance-dependent routing for plastics/mixed waste.

tasks.title: Create attributed price seed and observation pipeline
tasks.output: Import dated public buying/quoted/selling observations, unit/geography/condition/source metadata and licence/usage notes; partition demo series; add authenticated observation entry and review. Never fill missing live prices with synthetic rows.

tasks.title: Build Delhi-NCR and Maharashtra facility directory
tasks.output: Import small CPCB/DPCC/MPCB subsets; preserve facility role, registry/list date, route registration, validity, material acceptance evidence and field lineage; review geocodes, deduplicate facilities, and mark unknown pickup/rates as unknown.

tasks.title: Implement Android Room repositories and durable outbox
tasks.output: Implement local entities, migrations, atomic object+event+outbox write, staged image persistence, cache reads, user partition and logout preservation. Prove process death cannot show a saved record that was lost.

tasks.title: Implement server synchronization protocol
tasks.output: Implement push per-operation responses, dependency ordering, expected versions, payload fingerprints, atomic idempotency storage and pull deltas/tombstones. Prove crash-after-commit retry produces one domain effect.

tasks.title: Implement Android background and manual synchronization
tasks.output: Drain durable outbox through unique WorkManager jobs, network constraints/backoff and foreground/manual action; handle 401/409/422/429/5xx, partial media uploads and ACK loss; persist cursors only after local transaction commit.

tasks.title: Implement lot and lifecycle backend
tasks.output: Create/update/list/cancel lot commands with owner checks, positive weight and validation, immutable estimates/suggestions, location quality, photos and transition events; prohibit direct arbitrary status PATCH.

tasks.title: Implement approved collector onboarding and lot screens
tasks.output: Implement C01–C05,C14,C15 as approved Compose screens; use Room-only reads, photo permission/import fallback, manual material selection, condition/weight, resumable drafts, local save result, language/session/sync states. Model integration arrives in T034.

tasks.title: Implement price statistics and snapshot valuation
tasks.output: Implement comparable observation filtering, weighted quantiles, confidence, history, sparse/stale/missing handling and per-lot immutable valuation snapshots. Publish shared fixtures for Python/Kotlin parity and preserve quote vs final amount semantics.

tasks.title: Implement eligible recycler matching and map data
tasks.output: Implement hard route/material/status/service/weight filters, PostGIS distance, normalized scoring and explanation, missing-data rules, top candidates and no-match behavior; publish offline parity fixtures and cache policy.

tasks.title: Implement approved collector price and recycler views
tasks.output: Implement C06–C09: board/trends, source details, observation entry, estimates, quote comparisons, directory/list/details and online map; cache age, no price/no match and permission-denied states; selection offline is intent only.

tasks.title: Implement recycler profile and offer workflows
tasks.output: Implement facility-user linkage, self-declared operational profile, material/rate/pickup updates, incoming requests, offer/reject/expiry, collector acceptance with one active agreement, cancellation and immutable terms.

tasks.title: Implement approved recycler console and phone layout
tasks.output: Implement R01–R03,R06,R07 responsive React/Vite views for authorized facility users; incoming/lot evidence/offer/profile/history interactions; R07 export wiring is completed in T031; work on borrowed second Android phone without a separate recycler APK.

tasks.title: Implement handover proposals and confirmations
tasks.output: Implement pending proposal, canonical payload/hash/event chain, authenticated recycler confirmation, collector acknowledgement of changes, duplicate-safe outcome, disputes and immutable revision links; create minimal public verification response.

tasks.title: Implement approved offline QR and collector receipt
tasks.output: Implement C10,C11,C16: local pending handover with photo/weight/location/time, SHA-256 and QR, Android PdfDocument, share and passport timeline. Clearly distinguish pending local hash check from server-confirmed record and protect PII.

tasks.title: Implement approved second-phone QR confirmation
tasks.output: Implement R04,R05,V01 in responsive web; HTTPS camera scan plus reference-entry fallback, unknown-unsynced QR state, review/confirm measured terms, pending collector acknowledgement, public redacted verification and replay/conflict tests.

tasks.title: Implement payment assertions and earnings projections
tasks.output: Record cash/UPI/other payment assertions with actor/time and acknowledgement/dispute; partial amounts and append-only reversals; derive gross/paid/pending totals without double counting; close only at confirmed receipt and acknowledged settled payment.

tasks.title: Implement approved ledger and payment screens
tasks.output: Implement C12,C13 and R05 payment/history portions; monthly/filter summaries, transaction detail, offline pending payment assertion, dues and disagreement; no implication that the app executes or bank-verifies money transfer.

tasks.title: Implement data-quality and anomaly rules
tasks.output: Implement missing/invalid/duplicate/stale/inconsistent checks, price bounds, weight variance, image reuse and repeated events; record severity/reason/reviewer/resolution; no fraud accusation or destructive auto-correction.

tasks.title: Implement admin maintenance and metrics APIs
tasks.output: Implement admin directory review, material/alias/safety maintenance, price moderation, collector minimal view, event search, source/quality filters and aggregate metrics from persisted events; exclude demo data from real-impact totals.

tasks.title: Implement approved admin/data-quality dashboard
tasks.output: Implement A01–A07: overview, collectors, facility verification, price/material/safety source editors, traceability search, quality queue and secondary-research evidence links. All counts/drill-downs come from APIs.

tasks.title: Implement seven dataset exports and data lineage
tasks.output: Export all seven families as versioned CSV/JSON with provenance, safe redaction and manifests; produce handover PDF/CSV procurement logs labelled platform records; transaction outcomes feed reviewed price observations exactly once. Wire approved R07/A07 export downloads and manifest/data-card views end to end; verify actual files and permissions.

tasks.title: Curate licensed public image dataset
tasks.output: Select exact licensed datasets, save licence evidence and hashes, audit class relevance, deduplicate and group physical objects/source sequences into deterministic splits; document class gaps and no field-image claims.

tasks.title: Train evaluate and export on-device model
tasks.output: Train Keras MobileNetV3-Small, record seeded configuration, validation threshold, untouched-test metrics/confusion matrix, quantized LiteRT export parity and model card. Record failure honestly; no invented accuracy or borrowed benchmark results.

tasks.title: Integrate classifier into approved Android flow
tasks.output: Bundle model/labels/preprocessing/threshold/checksum, run off main thread, show real confidence and confirm/change/abstain; preserve suggestion and correction; test airplane mode, unsupported class, corrupt model and low-memory fallback.

tasks.title: Create contextual safety content and review path
tasks.output: Write short source-backed hi/mr/en material-specific safety cards and pictogram briefs for owner Stitch generation; version content, review hazards/routes and provide non-instructional battery/CRT warnings; no unlicensed image assets.

tasks.title: Complete language resources and accessible interaction
tasks.output: Implement all collector hi/mr/en strings, material aliases, accessibility labels, plurals/currency/units and numeral preference; preserve chosen language offline/restart; no hardcoded English critical errors.

tasks.title: Generate and wire offline Hindi/Marathi audio
tasks.output: Use free licensed voice workflow for bundled prompts and number/unit grammar; inventory rights/text/checksum/duration; wire tap-to-hear dynamic ranges, rupees/paise, per-kg, pending/success/safety; verify no runtime cloud call. T005 supplies shared licence/source-review tooling; image-dataset work is not an audio dependency.

tasks.title: Implement illustrative economics model
tasks.output: Create transparent current/platform same-lot calculator and attributed assumptions; acquisition/transport/handling/rejections/time/payment-delay sensitivity, negative/zero baseline behavior and hypothetical downstream fee/cost sustainability; keep separate from realized earnings.

tasks.title: Implement approved economics and safety views
tasks.output: Implement C17 safety hub/context cards and U01 interactive web economics, linked from admin/collector help where approved; clear illustrative labels and source drill-down; sliders/inputs update results; no preset claimed uplift.

tasks.title: Verify security privacy and abuse boundaries
tasks.output: Run owner/role/IDOR/replay/rate-limit/input/file-access tests; validate demo isolation, redacted QR/exports, no client secrets, token expiry/offline behavior, image EXIF removal, retention and backup controls; document residual limitations.

tasks.title: Deploy hosted API database storage and web
tasks.output: Prepare reproducible Render/Supabase/Pages configuration, verify current free-plan terms and account settings, apply migrations, private storage/CORS/TLS, release API URL and health check; validate over cellular/outside LAN. Publishing requires the owner's existing or explicit deployment authorization.

tasks.title: Prove local demo fallback and restore
tasks.output: Run same contracts with Docker PostgreSQL/PostGIS and media volume, real-phone LAN debug networking, localhost/HTTPS QR fallback; backup and restore database+media+manifests; test without internet. Do not expose debug cleartext in release.

tasks.title: Run cross-surface integration and fault acceptance
tasks.output: Run deterministic domain tests, price/match/hash parity, offline crash/retry/media/conflict/auth/device-clock cases and complete collector→recycler→ledger→admin journeys. Store logs and case IDs, fix failures and rerun affected checks.

tasks.title: Perform real-device and two-device usability tests
tasks.output: Owner uses real collector phone plus borrowed second Android browser; test camera/GPS/denial/restart/airplane mode/background/manual sync/QR, Hindi/Marathi and representative scenario usability. Identify tests as owner scenario tests, not collector fieldwork.

tasks.title: Measure entry-level performance and artifact size
tasks.output: Measure cold/cached launch, local save, compression, LiteRT latency, memory and APK including model/audio on named device; record p50/p95 and regressions, optimize lazy maps/assets without dropping required content.

tasks.title: Audit all translations and audio on device
tasks.output: Check key parity, Devanagari rendering, large text/TalkBack, numeric/range pronunciation, all error/pending/review states and offline audio; native-speaker review where available remains explicitly unverified until performed.

tasks.title: Freeze dataset and model evidence package
tasks.output: Produce release manifests, source/licence ledger, seven data cards, model card with actual results, data lifecycle demonstration, limitations and desk-research cards; distinguish facts/assumptions/demo rows and still-unmet primary fieldwork.

tasks.title: Prepare PPT and presenter handoff
tasks.output: Create final deck using verified implementation/screens and evidence; fill required organizer template, timing, five-presenter handoff, Q&A and honest limitations; remove stale statistics, EPR/credit/competitor overclaims.

tasks.title: Record and validate demo video
tasks.output: Record actual end-to-end demo with airplane mode, second-phone confirmation, two language audio, data quality and economics; publish/share link only with authorization; test link permissions outside owner account and retain local backup.

tasks.title: Package release and submission handoff
tasks.output: Produce installable signed APK, checksum/version/API URL, prototype web link, GitHub repository, PPT and video link; verify all RELEASE evidence and no missing tasks. Check official portal fields/cutoff and obtain final submission authorization if not already given; record actual submission result separately.

tasks.title: Assisted collector and aggregator accounts
tasks.output: Explicit delegation/consent, actor versus beneficial owner, safe phone-less onboarding, separate permissions and offline ownership tests; no admin impersonation shortcut.

tasks.title: Multi-collector batching and pickup operations
tasks.output: Batch membership/weights/provenance and collector-level proceeds reconcile; operational capacity and actual pickup success recorded; no double counting.

tasks.title: Predictive prices and automated public feeds
tasks.output: Licensed sustained comparable observations, temporal holdout against statistical baseline, uncertainty/drift monitoring and a permitted refresh pipeline; keep indicative labels.

tasks.title: Consented active learning and broader classifier
tasks.output: New consent/rights policy, reviewed correction labels, expanded relevant classes, leakage-safe evaluation and version rollback; current release remains public-images-only.

tasks.title: Learned recycler ranking and advanced risk detection
tasks.output: Enough quality outcome labels, temporal evaluation/fairness/reason codes, human review and safety hard filters; do not learn to override route eligibility or accuse fraud.

tasks.title: Voice input and multilingual assistant
tasks.output: Free/licensed offline ASR where viable, hi/mr noisy-environment tests, explicit confirmation of money/material values and manual fallback; no arbitrary autonomous transaction agent.

tasks.title: Pickup route optimization
tasks.output: Consented operational locations, realistic vehicle/capacity/time windows, permitted map data and measured routing baseline; no continuous collector tracking by default.

tasks.title: ERP GST PRO brand and CPCB adapters
tasks.output: Documented official/partner API contracts, credentials and legal role, validated field mapping/sandbox evidence, access/audit controls; no claim of integration or certificate issuance before verification.

tasks.title: Downstream processing and material mass balance
tasks.output: Recycler processing evidence, batch splits/merges/yield reconciliation and independently supported downstream outcomes before calling received mass recycled.

tasks.title: Ed25519 server-signed records
tasks.output: Canonical payload parity, secure signing keys/rotation/revocation/trusted public-key distribution and verification fixtures; signature still does not prove physical facts.

tasks.title: Recovery indicator and environmental estimates
tasks.output: Exact peer-reviewed composition/LCA sources, material/device-specific uncertainty and defensible model validation; no invented official formula, exact metal yield or unsupported CO2 savings. Owner must explicitly promote this optional idea.

tasks.title: Supervised real-world pilot and partnerships
tasks.output: Consented real collectors/facilities, review safety/privacy/retention/support, actual partnership evidence and measured feedback; historical 5–10/20–30 counts are planning suggestions.

tasks.title: More regions languages and material routes
tasks.output: Region/language source and review coverage, safe route-specific authorization and model/material validation; preserve e-waste focus until explicit expansion.

tasks.title: Aggregated sector and government insights
tasks.output: Adequate representative data, aggregation/privacy controls and sample/denominator limitations for supply/capacity gaps, volatility/material flows/safety; no prototype national statistics.

tasks.title: Advanced dispute review and support workflow
tasks.output: Evidence submission/reviewer permissions/appeal/resolution timeline, immutable original quote/final terms and policy; basic pending/disputed states already required in release.

tasks.title: Optional payments messaging and monetization
tasks.output: Separate owner approval, lawful provider terms, fee transparency, webhook idempotency and reconciled settlement; SMS/WhatsApp/email/real UPI/paid SaaS not release dependencies.

tasks.title: Collector identity sharing and partner services
tasks.output: Minimal revocable identity QR/consent-scoped history sharing; verified partner eligibility rules before any credit/welfare claim; never public financial profiles or guaranteed access.

tasks.title: Production operations and scale
tasks.output: Measured bottleneck/load and security requirements justify queues/caching/infra, incident support and disaster recovery; no speculative Kubernetes/microservices or blockchain requirement.

requirements.title: Consistent SahiTol identity and latest scope
requirements.acceptance: Inspect app, package metadata, repository and deck: SahiTol is the product name, the SIH title is retained only as the problem title, and no superseded stack or selected feature is silently substituted.

requirements.title: Owner-generated Stitch frontend gate
requirements.acceptance: For each implemented screen/state find owner notification plus Stitch project/screen/revision and approval; a missing design leaves that UI waiting and never produces an invented replacement.

requirements.title: Traceable continuous agent execution
requirements.acceptance: In a fresh session invoke session-start then session-continue: agent reconstructs state, reads task specs, selects an eligible task, preserves blockers and updates status/evidence before progressing without routine next-task permission.

requirements.title: Deadline and all four deliverables
requirements.acceptance: Release handoff contains tested PPT, accessible demo video link, installable APK/prototype link and GitHub repo; portal cutoff/format and actual submission status are explicitly recorded.

requirements.title: Native Android architecture and feasibility
requirements.acceptance: Approved feasibility screen on a named real Android phone captures photo, persists Room data through restart and performs offline LiteRT inference; Kotlin/Compose/Room/WorkManager remain the collector implementation.

requirements.title: Frozen API web database and storage stack
requirements.acceptance: Build and inspect API/web/database configuration: FastAPI, React/Vite, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, local volume and hosted private storage work through the documented contracts with dependency locks.

requirements.title: Minimal profile and phone/PIN access
requirements.acceptance: Register/login with phone and PIN; store no plaintext PIN; profile uses ID/alias/language/general area, asks for no Aadhaar/PAN/bank details and shows recoverable auth errors.

requirements.title: Role and object authorization
requirements.acceptance: Collector A cannot read/mutate B's lots; recycler A cannot confirm B's facility handover; collector cannot become admin by editing payload; invalid/expired tokens are rejected server-side.

requirements.title: Offline session and safe logout
requirements.acceptance: After successful activation disconnect and restart: local profile/drafts remain usable; expired token pauses authenticated sync; reauth resumes same operations; logout cannot silently discard pending data or expose it to another user.

requirements.title: Isolated demo access without SMS
requirements.acceptance: Bundled demo profile and demo OTP/bypass are explicitly labelled and isolated; public demo credentials cannot access non-demo users, verification controls or unrestricted admin actions.

requirements.title: Complete material taxonomy and aliases
requirements.acceptance: Create draft lots for CRT,LCD,PCB,cable,battery,motor/magnet,mixed plastics,mixed electronics and UNKNOWN; hi/mr/en local aliases resolve to stable IDs, not hardcoded price values.

requirements.title: Camera image import compression and privacy
requirements.acceptance: Take/import a photo, deny camera permission, retry capture and restart; saved image remains linked, upload validates type/size and strips EXIF; no-photo draft is allowed but evidence completeness is explicit.

requirements.title: Weight condition description and validation
requirements.acceptance: Save a draft then complete category/condition/description/positive finite weight; reject zero/negative/overflow values on submit; fractional kg round-trips as grams; suspicious large weight requires review without invented domain cap.

requirements.title: Collection and handover location/time provenance
requirements.acceptance: Record timestamps and GPS accuracy/capture age when permitted; denial uses labelled coarse/manual location or missing-data state; never fabricate coordinates or expose a home address in public records.

requirements.title: Durable draft lot lifecycle and cancellation
requirements.acceptance: Create/edit/reopen/cancel a lot with stable UUID and legal transitions; restart preserves drafts; attempts to mutate confirmed historical terms or jump CLOSED→COLLECTED fail and are auditable.

requirements.title: Price observations and in-app entry
requirements.acceptance: Enter an observation with material/subcategory, region, date, unit, price kind and source; edit via revision, moderate and export it; unknown dates or unsupported conversions are quarantined.

requirements.title: Indicative weighted range and lot valuation
requirements.acceptance: A known comparable observation fixture yields specified weighted median/Q1/Q3 and estimate bounds in API and Android; weight changes recompute estimate; screen labels result indicative and retains snapshot/version.

requirements.title: Source confidence freshness and empty prices
requirements.acceptance: Recent/few/stale/no-data fixtures show correct count, sources, timestamp, confidence and reason; no-data is INSUFFICIENT, never zero or a hidden synthetic fallback.

requirements.title: History trends and actual offer comparison
requirements.acceptance: View dated trend buckets and multiple offers in consistent units/regions; missing history displays a gap, no fabricated points; expired/noncomparable rates are labelled and do not become an agreed price.

requirements.title: Quote anomaly review
requirements.acceptance: Known low/high quotes trigger configured review reasons only when enough comparable data exists; alert says review, does not accuse fraud or block collector choice without a separate eligibility violation.

requirements.title: Source-backed Delhi-NCR Maharashtra directory
requirements.acceptance: Import CPCB plus DPCC and MPCB records with facility role/source document/page/date/registration and lineage; do not relabel a collection point as a recycler or claim that a list import creates a partnership.

requirements.title: Verification levels and expiry
requirements.acceptance: L0/L1/L2 never become verified formal destinations; stale/expired/revoked/unproven route authorization removes strong badge and matching eligibility even if original source was official.

requirements.title: Facility materials rates pickup and service area
requirements.acceptance: Facility user updates rates/availability/service area with provenance while authorization fields stay admin-controlled; unknown operational data stays unknown; acceptance/minimum-weight terms are visible.

requirements.title: Route-aware eligibility
requirements.acceptance: Battery lot cannot match a facility evidenced only for e-waste; incompatible material, unverified current registration or unsupported service/weight constraints exclude before ranking and before confirmation.

requirements.title: Explainable ranking with geography
requirements.acceptance: Run fixed candidates: deterministic score and tie-break, PostGIS distance online, cached local parity within tolerance; expose contributions and unknowns; never invent pickup, price or reliability.

requirements.title: Offline list online map and no-match path
requirements.acceptance: With network/maps/GPS unavailable directory list works with cached age and distance when possible; no-match can save/widen geography, never switch battery route; online MapLibre includes attribution and permitted tiles.

requirements.title: Recycler inbound offer accept reject workflow
requirements.acceptance: Collector submits lot, linked recycler sees evidence and quotes/accepts/rejects; collector selects one live offer; rejected/expired requests preserve history and can return to another compatible match.

requirements.title: Immutable agreed terms and offer races
requirements.acceptance: Two simultaneous acceptances leave one active agreement; cached expired offer cannot silently bind; later price-board refresh does not modify accepted terms; material/weight/price changes require explicit acknowledgement.

requirements.title: Offline pending handover evidence
requirements.acceptance: In airplane mode create UUID proposal with photo references, grams, location quality, time, parties/terms and hash; restart shows PENDING_CONFIRMATION and sync pending, never recycler-confirmed.

requirements.title: Two-device recycler confirmation
requirements.acceptance: Borrowed second Android browser scans collector QR over HTTPS, identifies the correct facility/lot, submits authorized confirmation and collector sees it after pull; unsynced reference explains waiting and supports retry/manual reference.

requirements.title: Canonical hash and append-only event chain
requirements.acceptance: Same frozen JSON fixture hashes identically in Python/Kotlin/web; one altered byte invalidates expected digest; original proposal and confirmation events remain linked and unchanged; UI never describes bare SHA-256 as a signature.

requirements.title: Public verification and privacy
requirements.acceptance: An unguessable receipt link shows current redacted status and record/hash comparison; public visitor cannot fetch phone/GPS/photos/payment details; QR possession alone cannot authorize confirmation.

requirements.title: Weight grade price disagreement
requirements.acceptance: Different measured weight/grade/price retains estimate and AI suggestion, sets pending acknowledgement/review and variance reason; neither party overwrites original facts; collector agreement or documented dispute is recorded.

requirements.title: Receipt PDF passport and procurement exports
requirements.acceptance: Export offline pending PDF and server confirmed PDF/CSV; identifiers/status/hash/provenance agree with timeline; record is called Digital Handover Record and includes non-EPR boundary, never an official manifest claim.

requirements.title: Cash optional UPI and payment recording
requirements.acceptance: Record cash without bank account/gateway; optional UPI/other records an assertion and reference, not transfer; both sides see actor/time/acknowledgement and can dispute.

requirements.title: Partial dues reversals and closure
requirements.acceptance: Two partial receipts sum once, duplicate operation does not increase paid total, overpayment is reviewed, reversal links original; RECEIVED with pending dues cannot become CLOSED; disagreement remains visible.

requirements.title: Collector earnings and transaction history
requirements.acceptance: Filter history/month and reconcile gross, acknowledged paid, asserted pending and remaining dues against transactions; offline view shows freshness; no demo earnings or estimates contaminate real settled totals.

requirements.title: Offline reference and local core journey
requirements.acceptance: After bootstrap, airplane mode still allows material/safety/price/directory/history reads and photo/category/weight/lot/pending handover writes; fresh install offers clearly labelled demo reference or activation requirement, never an empty misleading success state.

requirements.title: Atomic durable outbox and image survival
requirements.acceptance: Kill process during/after local save and media staging; either fully recover object+event+outbox+file or report unsaved failure; never drop a pending record through migration, cleanup or storage pressure.

requirements.title: Idempotency and partial batch acknowledgement
requirements.acceptance: Resend an operation after server commit/ACK loss and in mixed-success batches; each accepted effect occurs once, different payload with reused ID conflicts, successful siblings stay acknowledged.

requirements.title: Versioned conflicts and dependency order
requirements.acceptance: Out-of-order lot/media/handover operations wait on parents; concurrent changes return current server version without erasing local proposal; reference tombstones update caches while historical receipts retain snapshots.

requirements.title: WorkManager retries foreground sync and auth pause
requirements.acceptance: With intermittent network/reboot/background restriction sync resumes durably or via manual button; 401 pauses for auth, 409 review, 422 repair, 429 backoff and 5xx retry without busy loop or lost records.

requirements.title: Visible queue and recoverable failure states
requirements.acceptance: Collector can distinguish local/sending/synced/needs-login/conflict/rejected, inspect queue count/last sync, retry safely and retain a support reference; no generic green success on HTTP failure.

requirements.title: Licensed suitable public dataset only
requirements.acceptance: Every training image has permitted-use evidence, source/license/hash/class/object-group/split; no fabricated field images; class coverage report exposes generic datasets that do not cover actual e-waste taxonomy.

requirements.title: Reproducible leakage-free training and evaluation
requirements.acceptance: Train from saved configuration with object-group splits and training-only augmentation; report actual untouched-test macro/per-class F1, confusion matrix, counts/limits, calibration threshold and quantization parity.

requirements.title: Bundled offline advisory classifier
requirements.acceptance: Real SahiTol model predicts offline on phone with versioned preprocessing; user confirms/changes; low-confidence/OOD/corrupt-model fallback stays usable; no automatic certification, pricing or route determination.

requirements.title: Correction data and measured model constraints
requirements.acceptance: Persist suggestion/confidence/model version separately from human label; report correction/abstention denominators and inference/APK/memory on actual device; no training reuse without documented rights/purpose.

requirements.title: Contextual pictorial safety guidance
requirements.acceptance: PCB/cable/CRT/battery selection opens appropriate short pictorial warning in both languages offline; content is sourced/versioned and avoids instructions for unsafe processing.

requirements.title: Complete Hindi Marathi and English fallback
requirements.acceptance: All collector critical keys, labels, validation/denial/conflict/payment states and dynamic material terms work in hi/mr; language persists; unavailable translation is reported in audit, not hidden by English fallback.

requirements.title: Offline audio prompts and spoken prices
requirements.acceptance: In airplane mode tap Hindi and Marathi audio for changing price ranges, decimals, rupees/paise/per-kg and safety/pending/success; spoken value exactly matches visible value; asset licences and missing-clip behavior are recorded.

requirements.title: Low-literacy accessible approved interactions
requirements.acceptance: Core screens use approved icons/photos, short labels and tap-to-hear, primary 56dp mobile targets, no color-only status, at most three primary inputs per step; large text/TalkBack/numeric input and explicit numeral preference remain usable.

requirements.title: Entry-level Android performance
requirements.acceptance: Record named device, APK/model/audio sizes, memory and launch/save/compression/API/model timings against documented budgets; any miss stays visible with remediation, no borrowed benchmarks.

requirements.title: Material dataset reference and observations
requirements.acceptance: Export material observations with category/subcategory/description/image/weight/condition/source/value linked to lots while catalog remains distinct; new lot produces an observation through normal workflow.

requirements.title: Price dataset lifecycle and feedback
requirements.acceptance: Import→validate→review→aggregate→display→confirmed-transaction feedback→history/export works; one eligible transaction adds one sourced price observation; disputes/demo records do not contaminate real summaries.

requirements.title: Recycler dataset lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Import facility, review source/current status, update operational data, refresh/expire verification and export versions; original registry claim and later operational update remain separately attributable.

requirements.title: Transaction dataset generated by workflow
requirements.acceptance: A demonstrated lot→offer→handover→payment produces a transaction export with party IDs, original/final weights/values, locations/times and separate payment/lifecycle status without hand-inserting completion rows.

requirements.title: Traceability dataset generated by events
requirements.acceptance: Export collection through confirmed receipt/status events with evidence refs, weights, times, location quality, reference and confirmation; verify chain and correction lineage without mutable-history loss.

requirements.title: Minimal collector dataset and anonymization
requirements.acceptance: Export collector ID/language/general area/history/totals with PII redacted by purpose; onboarding and transactions generate it; public export excludes phone, exact home location and credentials.

requirements.title: AI training dataset card and tabular links
requirements.acceptance: Deliver training manifest/card with source, quality, size, labels, object splits and licensing plus nullable weight/price/location/transaction links where actually observed; absent measurements remain null, never inferred truth.

requirements.title: Provenance and demo isolation everywhere
requirements.acceptance: Display and export origin_class/source_kind/is_demo/date/version; public commercial data is not OFFICIAL; app-generated demo data is not real trade; mixed datasets disclose breakdown and synthetic lineage propagates.

requirements.title: Import cleaning geocoding and validation tools
requirements.acceptance: Rerun imports deterministically with checksums, preserve original documents and extraction locators, quarantine malformed rows, cache permitted geocodes and report accuracy; never silently discard or invent values.

requirements.title: Synthetic generator and edge-case scenarios
requirements.acceptance: Seeded generator produces labelled valid workflow fixtures and separate invalid/retry/duplicate/mismatch/stale/reject/cancel scenarios; re-running does not duplicate seed identities or label generated records official.

requirements.title: Seven data cards and versioned exports
requirements.acceptance: For all seven families deliver schema/version/count/source/license/validation/update/use/limitations and export checksum; counts reconcile with stored rows and demo filters; no completed card contains invented values.

requirements.title: Admin CRUD source and verification workflow
requirements.acceptance: Admin can review facilities, materials/aliases/safety, prices and source revisions; ordinary recycler cannot approve itself; edits are audited and sync to caches without rewriting old receipts.

requirements.title: Data quality review dashboard
requirements.acceptance: Dashboard calculates missing/invalid/stale/duplicate/inconsistent/source coverage and demo fractions; drill into a flag and resolve with actor/reason; all percentages have denominators and real query evidence.

requirements.title: Analytics and correct impact metrics
requirements.acceptance: Metrics derive from events with time/region/provenance filters: activity/quotes/matches/dues/disputes/sync/model quality and verified received grams; exclude demo and never equate received material with proven recycling or CO2 savings.

requirements.title: Illustrative unit-economics screen
requirements.acceptance: Change source-linked same-lot input assumptions and observe recalculated current/platform net, delta and valid percentage; show negative/no-benefit cases and explicit illustrative label separate from actual ledger.

requirements.title: Platform sustainability without collector fees
requirements.acceptance: Show hypothetical downstream fee revenue minus variable/fixed operating costs and break-even sensitivity; no fee actually charged, credit eligibility or guaranteed uplift implied.

requirements.title: Honest secondary research and personas
requirements.acceptance: Research package identifies each published source, its scope and design inference; personas/scenarios are labelled simulated; deck says no primary interviews completed and never invents participants or quotes.

requirements.title: Two working collector/aggregator field research
requirements.acceptance: This remains UNMET while desk research is the owner choice. Only actual consented engagement with at least two working participants and evidence could satisfy it; documentation or synthetic scenarios cannot mark it passed.

requirements.title: Receipt terminology and no false authorization
requirements.acceptance: App/PDF/CSV/deck call the artifact a platform Digital Handover Record; collector identity is not a licence; no official EPR certificate, government endorsement or established CPCB integration is claimed.

requirements.title: PIN abuse secrets and transport safety
requirements.acceptance: Rate-limit PIN attempts, restrict role grants, rotate/revoke sessions, verify release HTTPS and restrictive CORS; APK/web/repo/log/QR contain no server key, PIN or private database credentials.

requirements.title: Privacy media access retention and audit
requirements.acceptance: Private images require authorization; signed URLs expire; uploads cannot traverse filesystem; exports redact PII; retention/deletion policy preserves justified audit and pending data while clearing obsolete access safely.

requirements.title: Hosted remote judge access
requirements.acceptance: Install release APK and open web console outside developer Wi-Fi; HTTPS API, PostGIS, private storage and QR work; cold start has recoverable UI; persistent photos survive API redeploy.

requirements.title: Reproducible local fallback and recovery
requirements.acceptance: Fresh local Compose environment runs same schema and fixture journey; Android debug LAN configuration works; database/media restore rehearsed; browser scan fallback handles insecure local camera context without weakening release TLS.

requirements.title: No required paid runtime dependency
requirements.acceptance: Audit dependency/service/config list and execute core with cloud speech/maps/AI unavailable; no mandatory SMS, LLM, payment gateway, custom domain or billing upgrade is required; current free-plan/account limitations documented.

requirements.title: Monitoring and diagnostics
requirements.acceptance: Health and redacted structured logs expose failed sync/conflicts/media/DB errors with correlation IDs; dashboard denominators and last refresh distinguish outage from empty data; actionable local recovery steps work.

requirements.title: Critical end-to-end and adversarial acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Pass online and airplane-mode lot→price→match→pending QR→sync→second-phone confirmation→payment→ledger→admin plus duplicate/crash/denial/stale/conflict/auth tests with actual logs and device evidence.

requirements.title: Live scenario demonstration and backup
requirements.acceptance: A person actually performs the complete journey on devices, records failures and fixes, and produces playable demo/backups; no unexecuted script or prefilled database is represented as live usability evidence.

requirements.title: Outsider documentation and presenter readiness
requirements.acceptance: New reader follows README to scope/architecture/decisions/data/run/demo; presenters can explain sources, offline pending vs confirmed, price limits, model limits, battery route and unmet fieldwork without relying on chat history.

requirements.title: Assisted collector and aggregator accounts
requirements.acceptance: Explicit delegation/consent, actor versus beneficial owner, safe phone-less onboarding, separate permissions and offline ownership tests; no admin impersonation shortcut.

requirements.title: Multi-collector batching and pickup operations
requirements.acceptance: Batch membership/weights/provenance and collector-level proceeds reconcile; operational capacity and actual pickup success recorded; no double counting.

requirements.title: Predictive prices and automated public feeds
requirements.acceptance: Licensed sustained comparable observations, temporal holdout against statistical baseline, uncertainty/drift monitoring and a permitted refresh pipeline; keep indicative labels.

requirements.title: Consented active learning and broader classifier
requirements.acceptance: New consent/rights policy, reviewed correction labels, expanded relevant classes, leakage-safe evaluation and version rollback; current release remains public-images-only.

requirements.title: Learned recycler ranking and advanced risk detection
requirements.acceptance: Enough quality outcome labels, temporal evaluation/fairness/reason codes, human review and safety hard filters; do not learn to override route eligibility or accuse fraud.

requirements.title: Voice input and multilingual assistant
requirements.acceptance: Free/licensed offline ASR where viable, hi/mr noisy-environment tests, explicit confirmation of money/material values and manual fallback; no arbitrary autonomous transaction agent.

requirements.title: Pickup route optimization
requirements.acceptance: Consented operational locations, realistic vehicle/capacity/time windows, permitted map data and measured routing baseline; no continuous collector tracking by default.

requirements.title: ERP GST PRO brand and CPCB adapters
requirements.acceptance: Documented official/partner API contracts, credentials and legal role, validated field mapping/sandbox evidence, access/audit controls; no claim of integration or certificate issuance before verification.

requirements.title: Downstream processing and material mass balance
requirements.acceptance: Recycler processing evidence, batch splits/merges/yield reconciliation and independently supported downstream outcomes before calling received mass recycled.

requirements.title: Ed25519 server-signed records
requirements.acceptance: Canonical payload parity, secure signing keys/rotation/revocation/trusted public-key distribution and verification fixtures; signature still does not prove physical facts.

requirements.title: Recovery indicator and environmental estimates
requirements.acceptance: Exact peer-reviewed composition/LCA sources, material/device-specific uncertainty and defensible model validation; no invented official formula, exact metal yield or unsupported CO2 savings. Owner must explicitly promote this optional idea.

requirements.title: Supervised real-world pilot and partnerships
requirements.acceptance: Consented real collectors/facilities, review safety/privacy/retention/support, actual partnership evidence and measured feedback; historical 5–10/20–30 counts are planning suggestions.

requirements.title: More regions languages and material routes
requirements.acceptance: Region/language source and review coverage, safe route-specific authorization and model/material validation; preserve e-waste focus until explicit expansion.

requirements.title: Aggregated sector and government insights
requirements.acceptance: Adequate representative data, aggregation/privacy controls and sample/denominator limitations for supply/capacity gaps, volatility/material flows/safety; no prototype national statistics.

requirements.title: Advanced dispute review and support workflow
requirements.acceptance: Evidence submission/reviewer permissions/appeal/resolution timeline, immutable original quote/final terms and policy; basic pending/disputed states already required in release.

requirements.title: Optional payments messaging and monetization
requirements.acceptance: Separate owner approval, lawful provider terms, fee transparency, webhook idempotency and reconciled settlement; SMS/WhatsApp/email/real UPI/paid SaaS not release dependencies.

requirements.title: Collector identity sharing and partner services
requirements.acceptance: Minimal revocable identity QR/consent-scoped history sharing; verified partner eligibility rules before any credit/welfare claim; never public financial profiles or guaranteed access.

requirements.title: Production operations and scale
requirements.acceptance: Measured bottleneck/load and security requirements justify queues/caching/infra, incident support and disaster recovery; no speculative Kubernetes/microservices or blockchain requirement.

tests.acceptance: Inspect app, package metadata, repository and deck: SahiTol is the product name, the SIH title is retained only as the problem title, and no superseded stack or selected feature is silently substituted.
For each implemented screen/state find owner notification plus Stitch project/screen/revision and approval; a missing design leaves that UI waiting and never produces an invented replacement.

In a fresh session invoke session-start then session-continue: agent reconstructs state, reads task specs, selects an eligible task, preserves blockers and updates status/evidence before progressing without routine next-task permission.
Release handoff contains tested PPT, accessible demo video link, installable APK/prototype link and GitHub repo; portal cutoff/format and actual submission status are explicitly recorded.

Approved feasibility screen on a named real Android phone captures photo, persists Room data through restart and performs offline LiteRT inference; Kotlin/Compose/Room/WorkManager remain the collector implementation.
Build and inspect API/web/database configuration: FastAPI, React/Vite, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, local volume and hosted private storage work through the documented contracts with dependency locks.
Register/login with phone and PIN; store no plaintext PIN; profile uses ID/alias/language/general area, asks for no Aadhaar/PAN/bank details and shows recoverable auth errors.
Collector A cannot read/mutate B's lots; recycler A cannot confirm B's facility handover; collector cannot become admin by editing payload; invalid/expired tokens are rejected server-side.

After successful activation disconnect and restart: local profile/drafts remain usable; expired token pauses authenticated sync; reauth resumes same operations; logout cannot silently discard pending data or expose it to another user.
Bundled demo profile and demo OTP/bypass are explicitly labelled and isolated; public demo credentials cannot access non-demo users, verification controls or unrestricted admin actions.
Create draft lots for CRT,LCD,PCB,cable,battery,motor/magnet,mixed plastics,mixed electronics and UNKNOWN; hi/mr/en local aliases resolve to stable IDs, not hardcoded price values.

Take/import a photo, deny camera permission, retry capture and restart; saved image remains linked, upload validates type/size and strips EXIF; no-photo draft is allowed but evidence completeness is explicit.

Save a draft then complete category/condition/description/positive finite weight; reject zero/negative/overflow values on submit; fractional kg round-trips as grams; suspicious large weight requires review without invented domain cap.

Record timestamps and GPS accuracy/capture age when permitted; denial uses labelled coarse/manual location or missing-data state; never fabricate coordinates or expose a home address in public records.
Create/edit/reopen/cancel a lot with stable UUID and legal transitions; restart preserves drafts; attempts to mutate confirmed historical terms or jump CLOSED→COLLECTED fail and are auditable.
Enter an observation with material/subcategory, region, date, unit, price kind and source; edit via revision, moderate and export it; unknown dates or unsupported conversions are quarantined.

A known comparable observation fixture yields specified weighted median/Q1/Q3 and estimate bounds in API and Android; weight changes recompute estimate; screen labels result indicative and retains snapshot/version.
Recent/few/stale/no-data fixtures show correct count, sources, timestamp, confidence and reason; no-data is INSUFFICIENT, never zero or a hidden synthetic fallback.

View dated trend buckets and multiple offers in consistent units/regions; missing history displays a gap, no fabricated points; expired/noncomparable rates are labelled and do not become an agreed price.

Known low/high quotes trigger configured review reasons only when enough comparable data exists; alert says review, does not accuse fraud or block collector choice without a separate eligibility violation.

Import CPCB plus DPCC and MPCB records with facility role/source document/page/date/registration and lineage; do not relabel a collection point as a recycler or claim that a list import creates a partnership.
L0/L1/L2 never become verified formal destinations; stale/expired/revoked/unproven route authorization removes strong badge and matching eligibility even if original source was official.

Facility user updates rates/availability/service area with provenance while authorization fields stay admin-controlled; unknown operational data stays unknown; acceptance/minimum-weight terms are visible.

Battery lot cannot match a facility evidenced only for e-waste; incompatible material, unverified current registration or unsupported service/weight constraints exclude before ranking and before confirmation.
Run fixed candidates: deterministic score and tie-break, PostGIS distance online, cached local parity within tolerance; expose contributions and unknowns; never invent pickup, price or reliability.

With network/maps/GPS unavailable directory list works with cached age and distance when possible; no-match can save/widen geography, never switch battery route; online MapLibre includes attribution and permitted tiles.

Collector submits lot, linked recycler sees evidence and quotes/accepts/rejects; collector selects one live offer; rejected/expired requests preserve history and can return to another compatible match.

Two simultaneous acceptances leave one active agreement; cached expired offer cannot silently bind; later price-board refresh does not modify accepted terms; material/weight/price changes require explicit acknowledgement.
In airplane mode create UUID proposal with photo references, grams, location quality, time, parties/terms and hash; restart shows PENDING_CONFIRMATION and sync pending, never recycler-confirmed.

Borrowed second Android browser scans collector QR over HTTPS, identifies the correct facility/lot, submits authorized confirmation and collector sees it after pull; unsynced reference explains waiting and supports retry/manual reference.

Same frozen JSON fixture hashes identically in Python/Kotlin/web; one altered byte invalidates expected digest; original proposal and confirmation events remain linked and unchanged; UI never describes bare SHA-256 as a signature.
An unguessable receipt link shows current redacted status and record/hash comparison; public visitor cannot fetch phone/GPS/photos/payment details; QR possession alone cannot authorize confirmation.

Different measured weight/grade/price retains estimate and AI suggestion, sets pending acknowledgement/review and variance reason; neither party overwrites original facts; collector agreement or documented dispute is recorded.

Export offline pending PDF and server confirmed PDF/CSV; identifiers/status/hash/provenance agree with timeline; record is called Digital Handover Record and includes non-EPR boundary, never an official manifest claim.
Record cash without bank account/gateway; optional UPI/other records an assertion and reference, not transfer; both sides see actor/time/acknowledgement and can dispute.

Two partial receipts sum once, duplicate operation does not increase paid total, overpayment is reviewed, reversal links original; RECEIVED with pending dues cannot become CLOSED; disagreement remains visible.

Filter history/month and reconcile gross, acknowledged paid, asserted pending and remaining dues against transactions; offline view shows freshness; no demo earnings or estimates contaminate real settled totals.

After bootstrap, airplane mode still allows material/safety/price/directory/history reads and photo/category/weight/lot/pending handover writes; fresh install offers clearly labelled demo reference or activation requirement, never an empty misleading success state.

Kill process during/after local save and media staging; either fully recover object+event+outbox+file or report unsaved failure; never drop a pending record through migration, cleanup or storage pressure.
Resend an operation after server commit/ACK loss and in mixed-success batches; each accepted effect occurs once, different payload with reused ID conflicts, successful siblings stay acknowledged.

Out-of-order lot/media/handover operations wait on parents; concurrent changes return current server version without erasing local proposal; reference tombstones update caches while historical receipts retain snapshots.

With intermittent network/reboot/background restriction sync resumes durably or via manual button; 401 pauses for auth, 409 review, 422 repair, 429 backoff and 5xx retry without busy loop or lost records.
Collector can distinguish local/sending/synced/needs-login/conflict/rejected, inspect queue count/last sync, retry safely and retain a support reference; no generic green success on HTTP failure.

Every training image has permitted-use evidence, source/license/hash/class/object-group/split; no fabricated field images; class coverage report exposes generic datasets that do not cover actual e-waste taxonomy.

Train from saved configuration with object-group splits and training-only augmentation; report actual untouched-test macro/per-class F1, confusion matrix, counts/limits, calibration threshold and quantization parity.

Real SahiTol model predicts offline on phone with versioned preprocessing; user confirms/changes; low-confidence/OOD/corrupt-model fallback stays usable; no automatic certification, pricing or route determination.

Persist suggestion/confidence/model version separately from human label; report correction/abstention denominators and inference/APK/memory on actual device; no training reuse without documented rights/purpose.
PCB/cable/CRT/battery selection opens appropriate short pictorial warning in both languages offline; content is sourced/versioned and avoids instructions for unsafe processing.

All collector critical keys, labels, validation/denial/conflict/payment states and dynamic material terms work in hi/mr; language persists; unavailable translation is reported in audit, not hidden by English fallback.

In airplane mode tap Hindi and Marathi audio for changing price ranges, decimals, rupees/paise/per-kg and safety/pending/success; spoken value exactly matches visible value; asset licences and missing-clip behavior are recorded.

Core screens use approved icons/photos, short labels and tap-to-hear, primary 56dp mobile targets, no color-only status, at most three primary inputs per step; large text/TalkBack/numeric input and explicit numeral preference remain usable.
Record named device, APK/model/audio sizes, memory and launch/save/compression/API/model timings against documented budgets; any miss stays visible with remediation, no borrowed benchmarks.

Export material observations with category/subcategory/description/image/weight/condition/source/value linked to lots while catalog remains distinct; new lot produces an observation through normal workflow.
